recognize_zh: 這是 G-banding 核型圖而非形態圖：每號染色體各有四條（四倍體），第15與17號各有兩條以箭頭標示的異常染色體，核型式為 92,XXXX,t(15;17)(q22;q12)x2[20]，代表 PML::RARA 易位隨四倍體化而加倍。
features: G-banded karyogram, not a morphologic image
Four copies of each autosome and four X chromosomes (near-tetraploid, 92 chromosomes)
Arrows mark two derivative chromosome 15s and two derivative chromosome 17s
Banding resolution is modest; derivatives are identified by arrows rather than detailed band morphology
describe_en: This is a G-banded karyogram showing a near-tetraploid female karyotype with four copies of each autosome and four X chromosomes. Arrows indicate two der(15) and two der(17) chromosomes, representing a duplicated t(15;17)(q22;q12) in all 20 metaphases analyzed, written as 92,XXXX,t(15;17)(q22;q12)x2[20]. This indicates endoreduplication of a clone carrying the PML::RARA fusion. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia with a tetraploid karyotype; FISH or RT-PCR for PML::RARA confirms the fusion.
